steps: Biostatistics is the branch of biology in which statistical methods are applied to biological data.
It helps in the collection, organization, presentation, analysis and interpretation of biological data.
items.finalAnswer: Biostatistics applies statistical methods to biological data.

steps: The median is the middle value of a data set when its values are arranged in ascending or descending order.
If the number of values is even, the median is the mean of the two middle values.
items.finalAnswer: The median is the middle value of an ordered data set.

steps: Add all the values in the data set.
Divide their sum by the total number of values.
Mean = sum of all values ÷ number of values.
items.finalAnswer: The mean is calculated by dividing the sum of all values by the number of values.

steps: The height of a bar represents the frequency or value of the category shown by that bar.
A taller bar represents a greater frequency or value.
items.finalAnswer: The height of a bar represents the frequency or value of its category.

steps: The mode is the value that occurs most frequently in a data set.
items.finalAnswer: The mode is the most frequently occurring value in a data set.

steps: Biostatistics helps public health workers collect, organize, present and interpret data about health and disease.
It helps compare health information between different groups or areas and identify patterns, such as an increase in cases of a disease.
Health authorities use disease statistics to plan services and decide where to provide health workers, medicines and vaccines.
For example, data on the number and location of measles cases can help identify an outbreak and direct vaccination campaigns to affected areas.
Statistics can be used to evaluate whether a public health programme, such as a vaccination campaign, has reduced disease.
Thus, biostatistics provides evidence that helps public health authorities make informed decisions.
items.finalAnswer: Biostatistics helps public health authorities understand health data, plan services and evaluate health programmes.

steps: The mean is the sum of all values divided by the number of values; it uses every value in the data set.
For example, for 2, 3 and 10, the mean is (2 + 3 + 10) ÷ 3 = 5.
The median is the middle value after the data are arranged in order; for an even number of values, it is the mean of the two middle values.
For example, for 2, 3 and 10, the median is 3; it is useful when extreme values could distort the mean, such as when describing incomes.
The mode is the value that occurs most frequently; a data set may have one mode, more than one mode, or no mode.
For example, in 2, 2, 3 and 10, the mode is 2; it is useful for identifying the most common category or value, such as the most common blood group.
items.finalAnswer: Mean uses all values, median is the middle of ordered values, and mode is the most frequent value.

steps: Enter the categories and their values in an Excel worksheet, with a heading for each column.
Select the cells containing the data and their headings.
Open the Insert tab and choose a suitable chart from the Charts group, such as a bar chart.
Add a clear chart title and label the axes so that the data can be understood.
Use chart formatting options to choose suitable colours and styles, and adjust the scale or legend if needed.
Keep the chart simple and avoid unnecessary decoration so that the values can be compared easily.
items.finalAnswer: Enter and select the data, insert a bar chart, and add clear titles, labels and formatting.
